Rashi on Bava Metzia 65a:10:1.hebrew: טרשא שרי - למכור סחורה בהמתנה ביותר מדמיה, ובלבד שלא יפרש לו "אם מעכשיו הרי הוא לך בפחות", אלא ימכור סתם בכך וכך ליום פלוני:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 65a:10:1.english: Tarsha is permitted - [It is permitted] to sell merchandise on credit for more than its [current] value, provided that he does not specify to him, "If [you pay] now, it is yours for less"; rather, he sells [it] simply for such-and-such [an amount] [to be paid] on a particular day.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 65a:11:1.hebrew: קץ ליה - אם מעכשיו, הרי הוא לך בפחות, דבהדיא פריש ליה דשכר המתנה הוא נוטל:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 65a:11:1.english: He fixed [a price] for him - [Saying:] If [you pay] from now, it is yours for less, for he explicitly specified to him that he is taking payment for waiting.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 65a:12:1.hebrew: טרשא דידי שרי - עושה שכר תמרים היה, ומוכר לו בזמן הזול בתשרי כשער של ניסן, וממתין לו עד ניסן:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 65a:12:1.english: My tarsha [credit sale] is permitted - [Rav Pappa] was a maker of date-beer, and he would sell [it] to [a buyer] during the cheap season in Tishrei at the price of Nisan, and wait for him [for payment] until Nisan.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 65a:12:2.hebrew: שיכראי לא פסיד - אינו מתקלקל, והייתי יכול להצניעו עד ניסן:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 65a:12:2.english: My beer does not spoil - It does not spoil, and I could have stored it until Nisan.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 65a:12:3.english: I do not need money - For I am wealthy and am not pressed to sell at the current price.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 65a:13:1.hebrew: זיל בתר דידהו - אחרי הלקוחות, דאינהו ודאי אגר נטר יהבו ליה למר, דאילו הוו להו זוזי, הוה שכיח להו שיכרא טובא כשער של עכשיו:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 65a:13:1.english: Follow them - [That is,] after the customers, for they are certainly paying the Master a fee for waiting [for payment], since if they had money, plenty of beer would be available to them at the current price.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 65a:14:1.hebrew: אמר רב חמא טרשא דידי ודאי שרי - מוכר פרקמטיא היה, מוכר במקום הזול כשער שהוא נמכר במקום היוקר, וממתין להן, והן מעלין אותו למקום היוקר, והוא מקבל עליו אחריות דרך בהליכה. והלקוחות משתכרים בפרקמטיא שלוקחין שם במעותיו ומביאין לכאן, ואחריות החזרה עליהם. וכיון דלא מקבלי עלייהו אחריות, לא הויא מלוה גבייהו עד שהפרקמטיא נמכרת והן מקבלין המעות, ואותן המעות נעשין עליהם מלוה, ואין כאן רבית:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 65a:14:1.english: Rav Hama said: My tarsha [credit sale] is certainly permitted - He was a seller of merchandise: he would sell [it] in the cheap place at the rate at which it is sold in the expensive place, and wait for them [to pay], and they would bring it up to the expensive place, and he would accept upon himself the risk of the road on the outbound journey. And the buyers would profit from the merchandise that they would buy there with his money and bring back here, and the risk of the return journey is upon them. And since they do not accept the risk upon themselves [for the outbound journey], it is not a loan in their possession until the merchandise is sold and they receive the money, and that money becomes a loan upon them, and there is no interest here.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 65a:15:1.english: They maintain the market for them - [The authorities] proclaim that no person shall be permitted to sell until they sell.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 65a:1:1.hebrew: דלא נסתרי עבדיה - שלא ירגיל להיות בטל ויתעצל. נסתרי — התי"ו משמשת כדרך המתפעלים בתיבת שי"ן וסמ"ך, כאשר יתפעל שר ויאמר תשתרר, שהתי"ו מתמצעת להפסיק אותיות השורש, וכאשר יאמר בגיזרת סף — הסתופף, מגיזרת שח — השתוחח, וכן בלשון גמרא: משתרי, מיסתמיך, אשתהי, אישתקיל:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 65a:1:1.english: That his slave not be undone - So that he does not become accustomed to being idle and grow lazy. [In] "nisterei," the tav functions in the manner of reflexive [hitpa'el] forms in a word [beginning with] shin or samekh, just as when "sar" is put into the hitpa'el, one says "tistarer," where the tav is placed in the middle to separate the letters of the root; and just as one says in the pattern of "saf" — "histofef," [and] from the pattern of "shach" — "hishtocheach"; and similarly in the language of the Gemara: "misterei," "mistamikh," "ishtahei," "ishtakil."

Rashi on Bava Metzia 65a:3:1.hebrew: כי מפקינן מיניה - הרבית שלקח, כדרבי אלעזר דאמר: רבית קצוצה יוצאה בדיינים, דקיימא לן כוותיה לקמן (עמוד ב'):
Rashi on Bava Metzia 65a:3:1.english: When we remove from him - [i.e.,] the interest that he took, in accordance with [the statement of] Rabbi Elazar, who said: Fixed interest is exacted by the judges, as we hold in accordance with him below (65b).

Rashi on Bava Metzia 65a:4:1.hebrew: גלימא לא מפקינן מיניה - מקחו קיים, וקציצת הרבית יחזיר לבעליו:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 65a:4:1.english: We do not take the cloak from him - His purchase stands, and he must return the stipulated interest to its owner.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 65a:6:1.english: But let him say to him: When I rented [it] - When I rented it at this expensive price.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 65a:6:2.english: Since it was profiting me - It was coming to me at a profit.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 65a:7:1.english: One may increase [the price] for rent - As compensation for waiting for the rental money.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 65a:7:2.hebrew: ואין מרבין על המכר - בשכר המתנת המקח, ובגמרא מפרש טעמא:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 65a:7:2.english: And one may not increase [the price of] a sale - As reward for waiting [for payment of] the purchase, and in the Gemara [it] explains the reason.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 65a:7:3.hebrew: ואם של חדש בחדש - ואם תתן לי שכר כל חדש בחדשו, שלא תקדים לי שכר כל השנה יחד, תתן לי סלע בחדש:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 65a:7:3.english: And if [that] of a month [is] in the month - And if you give me the rent of each month in its month, [such] that you do not advance me the rent of the entire year together, you shall give me a sela per month.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 65a:7:4.english: And if for the harvest - And if I wait for you until the harvest, so that you will sell from your produce and give me my money.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 65a:8:1.english: Rent is paid only at the end - By law.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 65a:8:2.hebrew: אלא לבסוף - לסוף הזמן. הלכך, כי שקיל מיניה סלע בחדש, דהוו להו שנים עשר סלעים, אין זה שכר המתנת מעות, שהרי לא נתחייב לו לשלם שכירות עד סוף החדש. והאי דאמר ליה "אם מעכשיו תתן לי הרי היא לך בעשר סלעים", אי הוה מקדים ליה, הוא מחיל ליה מדמי השכירות ומוגר ליה בפחות משוייה. אבל סיפא גבי מכר, משמשך המקח, דינו ליתן המעות; וכי אמר ליה "אם מעכשיו תתן הרי היא לך באלף", הן הן דמיה, וכי מיטפי עלייהו לגורן, שכר המתנת מעות הוא:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 65a:8:2.english: Only at the end - At the end of the [rental] period. Therefore, when he takes from him a sela per month — which amounts to twelve sela — this is not payment for waiting for the money, for he was not obligated to pay him rent until the end of the month. And that which he says to him, "If you give me [payment] now, it is yours for ten sela," [means that] if he pays him in advance, he waives [part] of the rental fee for him and rents it to him for less than its value. However, [in] the latter clause regarding a sale, once he has drawn [into his possession] the purchased item, his obligation is to give the money; and when he says to him, "If you give [payment] now, it is yours for a thousand [zuz]," that itself is its price, and when he adds to it [for payment] at the threshing floor, it is payment for waiting for the money.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 65a:9:1.english: They examined it closely - They searched for it until they found a verse to support this matter, that payment of rental [is due] at the end.

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 65a:15:1.hebrew: נקטי להו שוקא - דאי לאו הכי הוה אסור, אע"פ שאחריות הדרך היה על רב חמא, שהרי היו טורחין לו להביא סחורתו ולמכרה בשכר הלואתו; אבל השתא דנקטי להו שוקא אף בחזרתן, הוי בשביל טורחן ושרי:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 65a:15:1.english: They maintain the market for them - For if not for this, it would be forbidden, even though the risk of the road was upon Rav Hama, since they were exerting themselves for him to bring his merchandise and sell it in exchange for his loan; however, now that they maintain the market for them even on their return, it is in exchange for their exertion and it is permitted.

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 65a:1:1.hebrew: ניחא ליה דלא ניסתרי עבדיה - פי' בערוך: לשון סתירה וקלקול. וא"ת: בלאו האי טעמא נמי פטור, דהא תנן (ב"ק ד' צו:): "גזל עבדים והזקינו משלם כשעת הגזילה", אבל שכר פעולתם לא משלם. ויש לומר דיש לחלק בין נחת אדעתא דגזלנותא לנחת אדעתא דמלאכה, כדמפליג התם גבי "התוקף ספינתו של חבירו ועשה בה מלאכה":
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 65a:1:1.english: It is satisfactory for him that his slave not be undone - [It is] explained in the Arukh: [this is] an expression of undoing and spoiling. And if you ask: even without this reason, he should also be exempt [from paying for the slave's labor], for we learned in a Mishnah (Bava Kamma 96b): "If one robbed slaves and they aged, he pays as of the time of the robbery," but he does not pay for the wages of their labor. And one can answer that there is a distinction between one who takes possession with the intent of robbery and one who takes possession with the intent of [performing] work, as [the Gemara] distinguishes there regarding "one who seizes his fellow's ship and performs work with it."

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 65a:8:1.hebrew: שכירות אינה משתלמת אלא בסוף - אפילו למ"ד בהגוזל קמא (ב"ק ד' צט. ושם ד"ה ואב"א) ובהאיש מקדש (קדושין ד' מח. ושם ד"ה דכ"ע) דישנה לשכירות מתחילה ועד סוף, מודה דאינה משתלמת אלא לבסוף, כדיליף הכא מקרא. ואפי' למ"ד אינה אלא לבסוף, מודה דפועל יכול לחזור בו ואפילו בחצי היום, וכשהוא חוזר הרי הוא סוף, שאינו רוצה לעשות מלאכה יותר. ולא נפקא מינה מההיא פלוגתא אלא לענין קדושין, דאי ישנה מתחילה ועד סוף, חשיבא מלוה ואין מקדש בה. ונפקא מינה נמי לההיא דפ"ק דמסכת ע"ז (ד' יט: ושם ד"ה אלמא): "הגיע לכיפה שמעמידין בה ע"ז — אסור לבנותה", וקאמר בגמרא: "אם בנה — שכרו מותר", ומפרש טעמא משום דישנה לשכירות מתחילה ועד סוף; ואימת מיתסר? במכוש אחרון; מכוש אחרון ליה בה שוה פרוטה:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 65a:8:1.english: Rent is payable only at the end - Even according to the one who says in [the chapter] HaGozel Kamma (Bava Kamma 99a, s.v. Ve'iba'eit Eima) and in [the chapter] HaIsh Mekadesh (Kiddushin 48a, s.v. Dechulei Alma) that [liability for] rent is incurred from beginning to end, he concedes that it is payable only at the end, as [the Gemara] derives here from a verse. And even according to the one who says [liability for rent] is incurred only at the end, he concedes that a worker may retract even in the middle of the day, and when he retracts, that is the end, for he does not wish to do any more work. The practical difference from that dispute is only regarding betrothal: for if [liability] is incurred from beginning to end, it is considered a loan and one cannot betroth [a woman] with it. And there is also a practical difference regarding that [teaching] in the first chapter of Tractate Avodah Zarah (19b, s.v. Alma): "[When] he reaches the vaulted niche in which they place an idol, it is forbidden to build it"; and the Gemara says: "If he built [it], his wage is permitted," and explains the reason is because [liability for] rent is incurred from beginning to end; and when does it become forbidden? At the final hammer blow; [and] the final hammer blow does not have the value of a perutah.

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 65a:9:1.hebrew: שכירות של שנה זו אינה משתלמת אלא בשנה האחרת - ואם תאמר: דבפ"ב דבכורות (ד' נג:) דרשינן דאין תורמין מן החדש על הישן משום דכתיב "שנה שנה", דמשמע אותה שנה עצמה? וי"ל: דהתם כתיב "שנה" בלא ב', והכא דרשינן מדכתיב "שנה בשנה" בב', דמשמע בשנה האחרת. ואם תאמר: דבפרק עד כמה (בכורות ד' כז: ושם ד"ה שנה) גבי בכור: "תאכלנו שנה בשנה" — "איזו היא שנה הנכנסת בחבירתה? הוי אומר: זו שנה של בכור", דלא מנינן לשנת עולם, שאם נולד בכסליו — שנת עולם מסיימת בתשרי — יאכל עד כסליו; והשתא ה"ל למדרש שלא יהא נאכל עד שנה אחרת ולא בתוך שנתו? וי"ל: משום דמוכח קרא דנאכל בתוך שנתו, דכתיב (שמות כב): "ביום השמיני תתנו לי":
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 65a:9:1.english: The rental [fee] of this year is paid only in the following year - And if you ask: In the second chapter of Bekhorot (53b), we expound that one may not separate terumah from the new [produce] for the old, because it is written "year, year," which implies that very same year? One can answer: There it is written "shanah" [year] without a beit [prefix], whereas here we expound from the fact that it is written "shanah be-shanah" [year by year] with a beit, which implies in the following year. And if you ask: In the chapter [entitled] Ad Kamah (Bekhorot 27b, and there s.v. shanah), regarding a firstborn [animal]: "You shall eat it year by year" — "Which is a year that enters into another [year]? You must say: this is the year of the firstborn," meaning we do not count according to the calendar year, so that if it was born in Kislev — [whereas] the calendar year ends in Tishrei — it may be eaten until Kislev; and now, should we not have expounded [from "year by year"] that it may not be eaten until the following year, and not within its [first] year? One can answer: [We do not expound it thus] because the verse proves that it is eaten within its [first] year, as it is written (Exodus 22[:29]): "On the eighth day you shall give it to Me":
